name: Supporting Partner
summary: For individuals who want to help the team in any way they can.
benefits: Your name on the supporters list on the NUFS website
A thank you in our social posts
Updates from the build through the season
foot: Every bit of support helps get a first car to the start line.

name: Community Partner
summary: For local businesses wanting to back student engineering.
benefits: Logo and link on the NUFS website throughout the season
Named in the season launch and end-of-year social posts
Invitation to partner events held at the university
foot: For organisations who want to back a local team from the beginning.

name: Team Partner
summary: A closer partnership with greater visibility and direct connection.
benefits: Active social media collaboration, your organisation featured in our content
Logo placement on a specific area of the car
Logo on sponsor backdrop and behind-the-scenes content
foot: For organisations who want their name on the car and a real presence in our story.

name: Innovation Partner
summary: For organisations that want their story told and a direct line to our students.
benefits: Dedicated sponsor spotlight content, your story, told to our audience
Increased logo placement on the car
Opportunities to engage directly with students, mentoring, recruitment, project discussions
foot: For organisations who want to meet the engineers, not just be seen by them.

name: Founding Partner
summary: For an organisation that wants a genuine role in shaping NUFS from the very beginning.
benefits: Prioritised and prominent logo placement across all team assets - car, kit, and materials
First right of renewal for future seasons
Bespoke student engagement - mentoring, placements, site visits, and graduates
Input into how your partnership is structured and developed over time
Recognition as a Founding Partner of NUFS, the team that started it all
foot: Founding Partner is not a fixed package. It starts with a conversation.
